question: As Newton is to weight, _____________ is to pressure.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pascal**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

 

• **Newton** is the SI unit of force, which is used to measure **weight**. Weight is the force exerted by gravity on an object. 

• **Pressure** is defined as the force applied per unit area. The SI unit of pressure is the **Pascal (Pa)**, which is equivalent to one newton per square meter (N/m²).
